ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.

Unique workable opportunities · Aug 26 – Sep 24, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Unique workable opportunities · Jun 27 – Sep 24, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

Date ranges on this page
Rolling 90: Jun 27 – Sep 24, 2026.

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Website traffic (GA4 cache 2026-09-25 · GA4 2026-06-27 → 2026-09-24): 55,707 visits · 49,565 people. Generated Sep 25, 2026 7:20 AM. This page is for Audi Baton Rouge only — no other stores.
Data coverage — Lead export only covers Jun 27 – Sep 24, 2026. This window is partial (effective Sep 1–24, 2026). Closed-deal (DMS) history may still be complete.

ICO trade cars that show up on our lot YMM join test

What this tests When a KBB ICO asks us to value their car, does that same year/make/model later appear in VinSolutions inventory (Used/CPO)? This is an acquired-metal / lot-fit signal, not proof the same person bought or that we bought that exact car from that lead. Join is year/make/model on Used+CPO inventory — not a person-level proof. Common trades can false-match. 'Arrived after ICO' means Inv Created Date is on/after the ICO open (minus 1 day). Active lot hit = that YMM is on the lot now.
